Sec. 5 directs the Panel to report by a deadline (July 31, 2005, moved to Sept. 30 and then Nov. 1, 2005 by EO 13379 and EO 13386). A report deadline is not an end; the clause ended with the Panel on 2005-11-15 (EO 13386 sec. 2).

Rule of construction (sec. 6: nonimpairment of OMB functions; no-rights disclaimer) that operates only while the Panel and the order operate; it has no independent object after the Panel terminated on 2005-11-15 (EO 13386 sec. 2 amending sec. 7). Flagged as the one scope question for review.

Rule of construction (sec. 6: nonimpairment of OMB functions; no-rights disclaimer) that operates only while the Panel and the order operate; it has no independent object after the Panel terminated on 2005-11-15 (EO 13386 sec. 2 amending sec. 7). Flagged as the one scope question for review.

Sec. 7 is the term clause. As issued it ended the Panel 30 days after its report; EO 13386 sec. 2 (signed 2005-09-30) replaced that phrase with "November 15, 2005", so the Panel terminated on 2005-11-15 (stated date). EO 13446 (2007) later revoked the order as completed work, 22 months after the end.

research_rationale:
EO 13369 (2005-01-07), 70 FR 2323 machine text (original_representation_unverified, acceptable_as_original). Sec. 1 establishes the President's Advisory Panel on Federal Tax Reform; secs. 2-6 staff and direct it; sec. 7 as issued: "The Advisory Panel shall terminate 30 days after submitting its report pursuant to section 5". EO 13386 (2005-09-30), 70 FR 58289, sec. 2 amended sec. 7 by deleting that phrase and inserting "November 15, 2005". The end is the stated date 2005-11-15, cited to the held text of EO 13386; the report deadlines (July 31, Sept. 30, Nov. 1, 2005) are deadlines and are not used as dates. EO 13380 (dossier gap "target provision not located: EO:13380") is a misparsed OFR note: it amends EO 12916 and was read directly. EO 13446 (2007-09-28, effective 2007-09-30) revokes the order after the end. Producer record OTE:EO:13369@lamm.

EO 13446 revokes the order on 2007-09-30, 22 months after the end: not an earlier end.", "independent_command_check": "No independent command survives the Panel: the Treasury support (sec. 4(a)), the Panel staff and meetings (sec. 4) and the FACA function assignment (sec. 4(f)) all concern the Panel; the report goes to the Secretary of the Treasury only as the Panel's work product.", "savings_check": "Read the order: no savings or exceptions; sec. 6 is a rule of construction (see savings reason).", "scope_check": "17 dossier scopes, secs. 1-7; all concern the Panel. Sec. 6(a),(b) are rules of construction with no independent operation once the Panel ends. No clause survives the Panel."}

savings.reason: Read the whole order: no savings, transfer or continuing-effect clause. Sec. 6(a) (nothing impairs OMB functions) and 6(b) (no right or benefit) are rules of construction that attach to the order while it operates; no pending matter, appropriation or function is saved or transferred when the Panel ends. EO 13446 (2007) revoked the order as a completed committee with no savings text.
